commits.summary: Add jvmcontract, a Rust library and CLI for the verifiers
Add Quorum, ten distributed-systems examples, and property proofs to jvmcontract
Add Crosscut, eleven Spring Boot examples verified by jvmcontract

prompts.text: This project demonstrates Java formal verification methods. The libraries used to create this are largely stale and minimal examples created pre-LLM by referencing academic papers. They also may not…
Create more novel examples of formal verification against Java bytecode using the jvmcontract library that feel exciting to expert Java distributed systems principals.
Create examples implementing formal Java bytecode verification using the jvmcontract library that will impress senior principals working in the Java Spring Boot ecosystem at top firms globally.
